items.source: When a "redirect:" prefixed view name is configured, there is no need to set this property since RedirectView will do that. However, this property may still be used to override the 3xx status code of RedirectView. For full control over redirecting provide a RedirectView instance.
items.translation: 当配置了带有 "redirect:" 前缀的视图名称时，无需设置此属性，因为 `RedirectView` 会自动处理。不过，仍可使用此属性来覆盖 `RedirectView` 的 3xx 状态码。如需完全控制重定向行为，请提供一个 `RedirectView` 实例。

items.source: The content of the "input" FlashMap is also added to the model.
items.translation: ``"input" FlashMap` 的内容也添加到模型中。

items.source:
If the status code is 204 and no view is configured, the request is
fully handled within the controller.
items.translation: 如果状态码为 204 且未配置视图，请求将在控制器内完全处理。

items.source: Return the configured HTTP status code or null.
items.translation: 返回配置的 HTTP 状态码或null。

items.source: Return the View object, or null if we are using a view name to be resolved by the DispatcherServlet via a ViewResolver.
items.translation: 返回 View 对象，或者如果我们使用视图名称并通过 ViewResolver 由 DispatcherServlet 解析时，返回null。

items.source: Return the name of the view to delegate to, or null if using a View instance.
items.translation: 返回要委托的视图名称，或者在使用 View 实例时返回 `null`。

items.source:
Trivial controller that always returns a pre-configured view and optionally
sets the response status code. The view and status can be configured using
the provided configuration properties.
items.translation: 一个总是返回预配置视图的简单控制器，并可选择设置响应状态码。视图和状态码可以使用提供的配置属性进行配置。

items.source: Whether the request is fully handled within the controller.
items.translation: 请求是否完全在控制器中处理。

items.source:
Set a view name for the ModelAndView to return, to be resolved by the
DispatcherServlet via a ViewResolver. Will override any pre-existing
view name or View.
items.translation: 为 ModelAndView 设置要返回的视图名称，该视图名称将由 DispatcherServlet 通过 ViewResolver 解析。将覆盖任何已存在的视图名称或 View。

items.source:
Set a View object for the ModelAndView to return.
Will override any pre-existing view name or View.
items.translation:
为 ModelAndView 设置要返回的 View 对象。
将覆盖任何已存在的视图名称或 View。

items.source: Rod Johnson, Juergen Hoeller, Keith Donald, Rossen Stoyanchev
By default this is set to false.
items.translation: 默认情况下，该值设置为false。

items.source: Return a ModelAndView object with the specified view name.
items.translation: 返回具有指定视图名称的 ModelAndView 对象。

items.source:
Configure the HTTP status code that this controller should set on the
response.
items.translation: 配置此控制器应在响应中设置的 HTTP 状态码。

items.source:
The property can be used to indicate the request is considered fully
handled within the controller and that no view should be used for rendering.
items.translation: 该属性可用于指示请求已在控制器中完全处理，且不应使用视图进行渲染。

items.source: Set a View object for the ModelAndView to return.
items.translation: 为 ModelAndView 设置要返回的 View 对象。

items.source:
Set a view name for the ModelAndView to return, to be resolved by the
DispatcherServlet via a ViewResolver.
items.translation: 为 ModelAndView 设置一个要返回的视图名称，该视图名称将由 DispatcherServlet 通过 ViewResolver 进行解析。

items.source: toString in class Object
items.translation: `toString` 在类 `Object` 中
